name: node_embedding_similarity
author: 96e40bd2
description: Learns DeepWalk-style node embeddings (random walks turned into vectors) and returns the nodes most similar to a given node by cosine similarity. Use for questions like 'which nodes play a similar role to X', 'which airports are structurally like Chennai', or 'who is positioned like member 1 in the network'. Similar here means a similar position and neighbourhood in the graph, not necessarily directly connected, and not similar attributes. Needs a node ID (use lookup_node first if you only have a name). Works on directed graphs (walks follow edge direction) and undirected graphs, weighted or not (weights are ignored). Deterministic for a given seed. Returns the top_k nearest nodes, each with id, label and a cosine score between -1 and 1 (higher is more similar), excluding the query node itself.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to embed, e.g. 'karate' or 'airports'. Use list_graphs to see the options.

node.description: Node ID of the query node whose most similar nodes you want, e.g. 'MAA' or 'm1'. Use lookup_node to find an ID from a name.

top_k.description: How many most-similar nodes to return.

walk_length.description: Number of nodes in each random walk (2 to 100).

num_walks.description: Number of random walks started from every node (1 to 100).

window.description: How many steps apart two nodes on a walk can be and still count as context for each other (1 to 10).

dimensions.description: Size of each node's embedding vector (2 to 128).

seed.description: Random seed for the walks. The same seed always gives the same answer.
